title: Smoked Salmon Soufflé
blurb: A light baked soufflé with flakes of smoked salmon and a hint of nutmeg.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and butter two ramekins thoroughly, then dust lightly with a little extra flour.
Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat, stir in the flour and cook for one minute, then gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened.
Remove from the heat and beat in the egg yolks one at a time, then stir in the chopped smoked salmon, nutmeg, pepper and parmesan.
In a clean bowl, whisk the egg whites until they form stiff peaks.
Fold a spoonful of the whites into the salmon mixture to loosen it, then gently fold in the rest until just combined.
Divide the mixture between the ramekins, filling them three-quarters full, and run your thumb around the inside rim to help them rise evenly.
Bake for 15 minutes until risen and golden, then serve immediately.
